attachments.name: 20-1589 Lease Agreement - Kidango, Inc. - Early Childhood Education and Family Support Program - Buildings H & I - Castlemont High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $18,000 yearly lease of two Castlemont High buildings to Kidango
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies a lease letting Kidango, Inc. use Buildings H and I at Castlemont High School for an early childhood education and family support program for low-income children in the Castlemont community. Kidango pays a one-time $18,000 plus $18,000 in annual rent for the term July 8, 2020 through June 30, 2021, and the lease began before the Board's vote.

attachments.name: 20-1406 Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement - The Integral Group, Inc. - Cole Administration Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $14,700 to The Integral Group's contract for the Cole Administration Center project
enrichment.summary: The Board amends a contract with The Integral Group, Inc. so it pursues CHPS green-building certification instead of LEED v4 and provides additional building-systems and commissioning work for the data center and multipurpose building. The contract limit rises from $57,500 to $72,200, paid from Measure J bond funds.

attachments.name: 20-1407 General Services Agreement for the Cole Administration Center Project to HERTZ Environmental, Inc. - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Hires HERTZ Environmental for $25,500 of stormwater pollution planning at the Cole Administration Center
enrichment.summary: The Board approves a contract with HERTZ Environmental, Inc. to prepare a Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan and help the district comply with the state Construction General Permit for stormwater runoff at the Cole Administration Center project. Work starts August 13, 2020 and is scheduled to last through December 31, 2023, paid from Measure J bond funds.

attachments.name: 20-1409 Amendment No. 5, Independent Consultant Agreement – Verde Design, for Professional Services for the Emerson Elementary School Soft Ball Field Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $40,750 and extends Verde Design's Emerson softball field contract to June 2021
enrichment.sourceIssueCandidate: The text says 'the former' (the District) provides reimbursable DSA fees 'to latter' (Verde Design), which appears to reverse the roles of the parties.
enrichment.summary: The Board amends a contract with Verde Design for the Emerson Elementary School softball field project, covering reimbursable fees paid to the Division of the State Architect (DSA), the state agency that reviews school construction plans. The added amount includes a $15,000 contingency, the limit rises from $266,360 to $307,110, and the end date moves from December 31, 2020 to June 21, 2021. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

notes.text: The text uses 'the former' and 'the latter' in an awkward order when describing who provides the reimbursable DSA fees, but the amount, vendor and project are clearly stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 5, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services between the District and Verde Design, Santa Clara, CA, for the former to provide to latter reimbursable Department of State Architect (DSA) fees, described in Exhibit A, attached to this Amendment, for the Emerson Elementary School Soft Ball Field Project, in an additional amount of $40,750.00, which includes a $15,000.00 contingency, increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $266,360.00 to $307,110.00, extending term of Agreement from June 7, 2018 through December 31, 2020 to June 21, 2021 and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant.
